svg.title: WUWEI: a day of delivery
svg.desc: Work items move along a track through Plan, Build, Check, Review and Merge while guards, cards and the heartbeat work under the hood; you approve the plan once and answer a card from the phone.
svg.text: A team of agents runs your delivery day. You approve the plan and answer the odd card.

g.text: quality: FIX, diverted to the fix lane
one fix round, then a delta check; forward only
D-3: client wants Friday. Allow once?
13:00 decision D-2 (Routine) taken under mandate: keep the retry, recorded for you
13:55 review: quality FIX on login fix; diverted to the fix lane, one round, then a delta check
D-3: client wants Friday. Allow once?
quality: FIX, diverted to the fix lane
one fix round, then a delta check; forward only
10:15 plan approved: 4 items, 3 seats (CAP 3), queue ranked by WSJF
11:40 csv export parked: blocked on a client answer, carried to tomorrow
12:15 guard caught a force push; the seat pushed the branch without --force
13:00 decision D-2 (Routine) taken under mandate: keep the retry, recorded for you
13:55 review: quality FIX on login fix; diverted to the fix lane, one round, then a delta check
15:00 decision D-3 (Consequential) answered from the phone: Allow once
15:20 PR #142 merged at the gated head; required checks green; branch deleted
17:25 close: report written, retro done, 2 rule changes proposed for you
